backgrounds: A single unchanging location for the entire reel: an outdoor park at golden-hour/sunset, with a soft-focus (shallow depth of field) backdrop of autumn trees in orange and yellow foliage, a hazy pale sky, patchy green grass with scattered fallen leaves, low bushes, and a barely visible park bench and path in the deep background. The camera does not move (static locked-off wide shot), so there is only one set and one composition used throughout the whole episode.

lighting_notes: Warm, soft golden-hour/sunset lighting throughout, with a hazy backlit sky creating gentle rim light on the characters' silhouettes. Lighting is constant and unchanging across every frame, giving a nostalgic, wistful mood.
color_palette: muted golden yellow (sky and title text)
visual_complexity_notes: Extremely minimal and stylized: one static wide shot, one simple set (seesaw in a park), no scene cuts or camera movement, and a shallow depth of field that blurs almost all background detail into soft color blobs. This minimalism is clearly deliberate, keeping all visual focus on the two characters' subtle facial expressions and the seesaw's tipping motion as the visual metaphor for the dialogue.
